posts.title: Raspberry — early growth, carefully slowed down
posts.content:
February · autumn-bearing raspberry · 25 cm pot · south-facing balcony · Last updated: Feb 07, 2026

The raspberry has clearly left dormancy and is pushing fresh, healthy shoots from the base.

Strong canes matter more than early growth.
